description: tools/test-projects/atmosphere (WEB_PROJECT=atmosphere tools/build.sh web): a volumetric height fog and Volumetric Clouds (Sky Map, the web's Low tier) in WebGL2. The canvas centre is fogged ground; its colour is the glcore golden's (engine/tests/core/golden/atmosphere_valley.png, centre 164 169 182): the volumetric fog leaves it as the analytic fog made it.
